implementation_notes: Rust's Clippy lints enforce some vocabulary (single_char_add_ident, module_inception); use the domain concept as the struct name and the domain verb as the method. Errors are part of the language — name error variants after the domain rule violated.
idiom_name: domain struct + domain-verb method + domain-named error variants
pitfalls: `struct Item2` / `struct Model1` inside a domain module
